newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Durango state sees '96 timber output up.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Durango state sees '96 timber output up.

text.p: Timber output from the northern Mexican state of Durango for 1996 could reach 2 million cubic metres, an industry spokesman said Thursday.

Annual figures for 1996 will be around two million cubic meters compared to 1995 production of 1,939,000 cubic metres, the state director of the Forestry Industry Association Gerardo Peyro Andrade said.
Durango is Mexico's leading producer of timber, and accounts for 36 percent of the domestic output, Peyro said.
